gap.second_gap_not_run: natural-language *routing* (no explicit application_version_id) also needs a route_control model that cannot be registered through the public API (internal/modelregistry/modelregistry.go:92-102); only SQL seeding exists.

journeys.failure: F08<->F04B product gap: the chat message is sealed verbatim as the Run input (internal/requests/submit.go:131 -> :646-690) while the executor requires a JSON object (internal/presetexec/linear.go:177-187); the Run fails with node_input_invalid before any sandbox work. assertions.name: control: the second read key works before revocation
revocation accepted

control: the short-lived key works before its deadline
an expired key is refused with the same invalid_key shape
the responsible human is disabled
the still-valid secret is dead on the next call after its responsible human is disabled
the disable transaction really revoked the service key (independent key row)

facts.responsible_disable_semantics: official PATCH revokes the responsible person's service keys (SECURITY.md §1) -> 401 invalid_key with revoked_at set; the 403 responsible_disabled branch needs a key row that survives the disable and is not reachable via this API

proven: scope: the same call is 403 insufficient_scope with a write-scoped key
ACL: the same call is 404 without the read grant and 200 with it
human: disabling the responsible human revokes the key (401 invalid_key)
ac2.not_proven: no single external write exercises API-key scope + resource ACL + a human approval at the same time: J5 is a read journey, J2's approval is a browser session decision over an internal capability call
ac2.product_support: the product can bind a service-owned Run's approval to its responsible human (internal/approvals/service.go:187-207 approverForOwnerTx), so this is a coverage gap in the delivered journeys, not a confirmed product gap
ac2.remaining_not_run: publish a version whose definition contains an approval-gated write node, submit it with a write-scoped service key that also holds the application grant, then have the responsible human approve and assert exactly one egress
